_doc: S105 (ROADMAP P3.9b; PROJECT_COMPILER §2.22): the custom SKILLS' own dialog
scripts + texts. The compiler emits them into EVERY build (bank $60
CustomScriptRead) after the project's own dialogue, so a field-cast skill
works in a project with no custom rooms. The script ORDER gives the id the
skill arms, from id 2 (0/1 are a no-op: 0 = 'the player' in bank $04
CheckPendingNPC): Anchor (bank $72 AnchorField14Tail) arms 2-5. Ids start
with 'skill:' and are reserved (a project may not define them). Moved
verbatim from the example project's medal_vault room ($71, scripts 2-5, S73)
— P3.11c makes them editable project data.

scripts.comment: [skill script 2] Armed by bank $72 AnchorField14Tail after the menu closes on a standard maze floor. YES: arm=1 (commit hook snapshots gate+floor), $D92B=6 + warp to Castle (14,5) = the WarpWing recipe verbatim. NO: end.

[skill script 3] Armed in town with an anchor stored. YES: arm=2 (commit hook installs wGateID/wCurrentFloor-1, charges 3/4 current MP on arrival, clears the anchor, arm->3 forces the standard maze in GateDecisionFork), then a staircase-style warp (flag $80; spawn ignored, the maze placement pass positions the player). NO: end.
[skill script 4] Anchor cast in a gate-like non-maze room (special/boss/custom).
[skill script 5] Anchor cast in town with no anchor stored (wAnchorFloor==0).
